title: [Shopify] Uptake Admin GraphQL API to version 2026-07
summary: The Shopify connector now supports the Admin GraphQL API version 2026-07 and handles market-driven shipping by reading shipping option names from market delivery settings instead of the deprecated merchant delivery profile APIs.
key_points: Updated API version from 2026-01 to 2026-07 following Shopify's deprecation schedule
Added detection of market-driven shipping model through ShopFeatures.marketDrivenShipping
For market-driven shops, reads shipping option definitions from markets.delivery.shipping instead of deprecated deliveryProfiles
Added new GraphQL resources GetMarketShippingMethods and GetNextMarketShippingMethods with corresponding enum values
Added test coverage for the market-driven shipping path with sample responses
quote: Handles the one 2026-07 deprecation that would otherwise silently break merchants: market-driven shipping.
